hero.title: An album made by your guests.
hero.text: Send every guest a personal digital invitation. After the wedding, all their shots and messages come together in one unique album.

invitation.title: A personal invitation for every guest
invitation.text: Every guest gets their own link with their name, the day’s schedule, a map and RSVP.

photos.title: Guests collect the photos
photos.text: Via their personal link or the QR code on the table, no app and no sign-up, in full resolution.

bigAlbum.title: A big album that builds itself
bigAlbum.text: Every approved photo lands on the board as a polaroid with the guest’s name. Show it on a TV at the party or order a poster.

custom.title: Or completely unique
custom.text: Send a request and our designer will create an invitation or big album just for you.
